title: Brassburg SMP
description: The Brassburg server is a 21+ whitelisted server focused on the wonders of Create mod. This pack is made to enhance the experience of create and all it's wonders.
body:
Our community is designed for players aged 21 and up! We are a whitelisted server that focuses on creating a warm, friendly, and wholesome environment where everyone can enjoy the game without toxicity. Whether you’re here to build, explore, or collaborate on amazing projects, you’ll find a group of like-minded players who value respect, creativity, and fun. By keeping our community mature and welcoming, we ensure a safe space for all to relax and play. Apply today and become part of our close-knit family! The better your application is the higher of a chance you'll be accepted!

[APPLY](https://discord.com/invite/TbA2m5APk4)
